description: Display faillog records or set login failure limits.

option.name: --all
tip: Display (or act on) faillog records for all users having an entry in the faillog database.

option.name: --lock-secs
tip: Lock account for SEC seconds after failed login.

option.name: --maximum
tip: Set the maximum number of login failures after the account is disabled.
A value of 0 places no limit on the number of failed logins.

option.name: --reset
tip: Reset the counters of login failures.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.

option.name: --time
tip: Display faillog records more recent than DAYS.

option.name: --user
tip: Display or maintain records only for the specified user(s).
A login name, a numerical user ID, or a UID range may be given.
